entities.name: Supplied 337 aa protein
observations: Sequence length is 337 aa; estimated molecular weight 36,769.75 Da and theoretical pI 8.56.
Pfam matches: Semialdhyde_dh (PF01118.31), residues 4–117; Semialdhyde_dhC (PF02774.24), residues 137–319.
Closest reviewed homologs are aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenases Q55512, P49420, and O67716, with 52.9–55.7% identity and 98.2–99.1% query coverage.
Homology supports EC 1.2.1.11 and NADPH-dependent formation of L-aspartate-semialdehyde from L-aspartyl-4-phosphate.
Reference annotations support homodimerization and roles in methionine, threonine, homoserine, and/or arginine biosynthesis depending on organism.
Exact substrate specificity and organism-specific pathway assignment remain inferred from homology, not experimentally established for this sequence.

entities.name: Aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase
observations: Reviewed homologs catalyze the NADPH-dependent reductive dephosphorylation of L-aspartyl-4-phosphate to L-aspartate-semialdehyde.
Reference enzyme annotations indicate EC 1.2.1.11, NADP/NAD binding, and homodimeric assembly.

entities.name: RHEA:24284
observations: Reaction associated with aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase: L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde + phosphate + NADP(+) = 4-phospho-L-aspartate + NADPH + H(+) (reported direction is reversible/unspecified in the tool output).

entities.name: Amino-acid biosynthesis
observations: Asd homologs contribute to biosynthesis of methionine, threonine/homoserine, and in some annotations arginine through the aspartate-family pathway.
